_comment: Your portfolio. The tracker fetches this file from GitHub Pages at boot, so editing it here and pushing to main is enough - no reflash. Each holding needs a ticker (Yahoo Finance symbol, e.g. NOVO-B.CO, AAPL, VWCE.DE) or an isin, plus qty. name and currency are optional; giving currency saves one API call per holding on first boot. NOTE: this repository is public, so whatever you put here is public too.
